name: Two-target: overtaking plus crossing from starboard
description:
A slow target is ahead on own-ship's track (overtaking case) while a second target simultaneously crosses from own-ship's starboard bow (crossing case).

Additional, beyond the 22 Imazu problems: a similar combination to Imazu case 7 (overtaking + starboard-crossing), at a different bearing/speed combination -- an extra sample point in that combination's parameter space.
pass_criteria: Own-ship keeps clear of the overtaken target (Rule 13) while also giving way to the crossing target (Rule 15/16) without conflating the two into a single miscategorised manoeuvre.
Minimum CPA to BOTH targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
